scope: Selected planar STANDARD MLINE, existing LibreCAD bundled codec, ASCII output from ASCII and Binary input. The standalone installed codec uses separate staged inspectors.

hookedProof.result: A test-only hook alters the staged MLINESTYLE record type after writing. The bundled writeVerified transaction refuses before publishing, preserves the seeded destination, and succeeds on corrected same-filter retry for ASCII input, Binary input and the style handle collision variant.

normalBuildReadback.result: All three cases pass without the test hook. ezdxf 1.4.5 verifies the MLINE group 340 and matching unique STANDARD MLINESTYLE and dictionary path, flags and cardinalities, and positions, directions, group-41 pairs and derived intersections within 1e-12. The collision case resolves source 1E to emitted 190.

review.findings: The scanner ignores unlisted style fields, treats a substituted polyline with a removed style provider as an allowed fallback, and accepts an altered group-41 value. A missing or ambiguous source-to-output anchor can also be skipped, leaving the stage unverified.

revisedScratch.changedGuard: Capture the selected MLINE and its emitted anchor during the write callback. Require the actual staged type, section, owner, common groups and ordered six-vertex model including group 41, and reject additional style fields. A separate visible-polyline fallback no longer substitutes for an expected emitted MLINE.
revisedScratch.tested: Twelve injected staged failures, covering a missing style provider, extra group 420, forged polyline fallback and altered group 41 across ASCII, Binary and the remap-collision inputs, refuse publication. Each retains seeded bytes and accepts corrected retry on the same filter. Direct scanner controls and fourteen neighboring provider/fallback checks also pass.
revisedScratch.review: The independent reviewer confirmed that the revised scratch scanner refuses the original three bypasses. The reviewer also reproduced accepted malformed generated-root owner, subclass, reactor and extra-field mutations, and padded group-2 identifiers. The 12 transaction cases qualify only the stated faults and profile.

scannerOnlyFollowUp.result: The isolated scanner now requires the generated root's exact common metadata and preserves whitespace in string values. It accepts the unchanged stage and refuses nine physical-byte mutations: four root faults, two padded-name cases and the three original review cases.
scannerOnlyFollowUp.scope: This follow-up has only isolated scanner evidence. The twelve transactional refusals belong to the preceding scratch revision.
